source.source_type: user-provided App Store Connect Sales and Trends SUMMARY / DAILY report reproduced in supplied plan
source.period: 2026-08-20 through 2026-10-29 inclusive (Apple PT reporting day boundary)
limitations: Downloads are a research signal only; they do not measure web search demand, queries, unique cross-platform people, or language preference.
No search volume has been imputed.

baseline.timezone_policy: Record the Search Console property/reporting date boundary and export settings; use the same property, boundary, filters, and dimensions for future comparisons. Do not silently shift dates.

status_definitions.published_existing: An already-published generic work-hours route is available in the 19 existing UI locales; this does not establish market-specific salary, calendar, or legal coverage.
status_definitions.preview_draft: Preview-only implementation; not a production claim and not eligible for public registry/sitemap until reviewed and published.
status_definitions.pending: Evidence or implementation is not yet available; never interpret as zero demand or a negative finding.
status_definitions.unassigned: No owner is assigned in this initial register.
